_comments._comment_datm_mode_basis: the name of the met stream that you are using as a basis for regridding
_comments._comment_din_loc_root: the path to the root of input data on your machine
_comments._comment_din_loc_root_clmforc: the path to the root of the forcing data on your machine
_comments._comment_new_loc_root: the path to the root of your newly created data
_comments._comment_new_loc_root_clmforc: the path to the root of your newly created stream data
_comments._comment_stream_list_file: an xml file that specifies everything about the different datm modes
_comments._comment_coords_mode: points or domain, the former uses a list of points, the latter uses a domain file
_comments._comment_target_lnd_domain: full path to the land domain file of the grid on which your simulation
actually runs (not the domain of the stream data your regridding).
If points mode, its simply a template, if domain mode it is
literally the domain you want for your run
_comments._comment_lat_list: list of latitude coordinates for points mode
_comments._comment_lon_list: list of longitude coordinates for points mode
_comments._comment_base_surf_files: base_surf_files: list of surface dataset paths to subset
